Activity different from budget, actual spending different from budget, or both.
Over-absorbed: add to profit. Under-absorbed: deduct from profit.
Debit: actual overheads incurred. Credit: overhead absorbed into work in progress. The balance goes to profit or loss.
(Actual hours - budgeted hours) × rate: the over- or under-absorption caused by the level of activity.
Budgeted overhead - actual overhead: favourable if less is spent than budgeted.
Overhead absorbed is less than actual; products were under-costed and profit is reduced by the adjustment.
Overhead absorbed exceeds actual; products were over-costed and profit is increased by the adjustment.

front: What a large difference tells management
back: The budget or the rate was unrealistic: revise the rate, improve forecasting, control overhead spending.
